title: Nobody Wanted Me in Their Party (Part 1)
summary: Rejected by every party in town, a boy goes alone to find his sister’s cure and comes home with the Dungeon King carrying his bag.
frame_0: A small boy with a lantern faces the stone dungeon gate beside a pile of bags. Armored knights, robed mages and hooded thieves flank him, and two ember eyes glow in the arch below the title.
package_differences: The opening composition drifts gently for 1.5 seconds to maintain the continuous camera.
The corner handle runs through the story. The supplied five-second Flashloop ending retains its original picture and audio.
In the wide return shot around 42.3 seconds, the boy's boot briefly intersects the corner of a stair.
